zh: 北德克萨斯大学（，经常通称为北德大，缩写为UNT）是位于美国德克萨斯州北部登顿市的一座大规模州立综合大学.

北德克萨斯大学设有自己的法学院和医学院，并且有自己的大学附属医院，是北德克萨斯大学系统（University of North Texas System）的旗舰大学. 北德克萨斯大学创立于1890年，当时是一座师范院校（Texas Normal College and Teacher Training Institute）. 北德克萨斯大学是美国南部最大的都市圈—北德克萨斯地区最大的大学. 校内拥有10个学院，开设有100个学士学位、125个硕士学位、50个博士学位课程. 本科生人数约有28000人 ，位列全美第10. 就专业来看，北德克萨斯大学的环境伦理和哲学专业的学生数规模位居世界首位. 北德克萨斯大学在音乐、艺术方面的课程享有极高的评价.

登顿校区位于德克萨斯州最大的人口密集地区，由美国人口普查确定的两个类别：（i）基于核心的统计区域（CBSA;达拉斯 - 沃思堡 - 阿灵顿，全国第四大）和（ii）组合统计区（CSA;达拉斯 - 沃思堡 - 第7大，全国）. 从经济的角度来看，登顿校区位于达拉斯 - 沃思 - 阿灵顿大都市区，根据美国管理和预算办公室的定义，截至2011年，该办公室的国民生产总值（也称为大都市产品）的第六高366大都市区. 作为一个州，德克萨斯州，2011年，在该国的GDP是第二高.
在过去四十一年里，该大学代表国家在其对国家的公民倡导中占有三个新的定位，资本密集的扩张.
1975年收购，随后在沃思堡成立了医学院. 2000年在达拉斯南部创建北德克萨斯大学-达拉斯分校. 该大学为该地区建立及奠定了第一所也是唯一的公立法学院的基础.
en: The University of North Texas (UNT) is a public research university located in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, United States. Its main campus is in Denton, with a satellite campus in Frisco. It serves as the flagship of the University of North Texas System, which also includes universities in Dallas and Fort Worth. UNT offers 114 bachelor's, 97 master's, and 39 doctoral programs. Founded in 1890, it was the 24th largest university in the United States by enrollment in 2023.

UNT is classified as an "R1: Doctoral University – Very High Research Activity" by the Carnegie system, the highest Carnegie designation for U.S. research institutions. It is designated a Hispanic-Serving Institution and Minority-Serving Institution by the U.S. Department of Education. UNT is also designated an Emerging Research University by the State of Texas and is one of four universities supported by the Texas University Fund (TUF). TUF was established with an initial funding of $3.9 billion and receives an additional annual allocation of $100 million as a permanent endowment, aiming to elevate participating universities into the top tier of national research institutions.

As of fall 2023, UNT enrolled 46,724 students, making it the third-largest university in Texas. It is also the largest university in the Dallas–Fort Worth area. UNT shares Denton with Texas Woman's University, the largest primarily women's university in the United States. UNT's main campus covers 963 acre, with academic buildings to the north and athletic facilities, including DATCU Stadium, to the south. The university's research park, Discovery Park, spans 300 acre and lies about five miles (8 km) to the north.

The university's athletic teams are the North Texas Mean Green. Its sixteen intercollegiate athletic teams compete in National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) Division I. North Texas is a member of the American Athletic Conference. UNT's official school colors are green and white and its mascot is an Eagle named Scrappy.

The University of North Texas's main campus is located in Denton, a city of approximately 170,000 in the northern part of the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, the fourth-largest metropolitan area in the United States. As the flagship of the University of North Texas System, UNT has steadily expanded its physical presence since 1975, when it acquired a medical school in Fort Worth.
